name: Paper trading of the CFD book bf2.2 (bf2 + Gen301 A / Gen302 A: spot-flow ridge with variance-risk-premium and weekend / Monday features, measured BrightFunded spreads)
registered: 2026-10-21, before the first bf2.2 paper hour; replaces the bf2 paper run (same sleeves; ridge model and cost model change)
what: Hourly forward test of bf2 = bf (C*, premium carry, trend 4h, Weiss expiry, deleveraging bounce, Coinbase premium on crypto CFDs) + Gen301 A ridge ML (Gen196 features + Gen247 B Binance spot taker flow + variance risk premium = Deribit DVOL minus 30-day realised vol + weekend / Monday dummies; BTC/ETH CFDs, 0.5 x clipped ridge prediction, decided at 00:00 UTC) + Gen234 'vol-managed indices' on US100/US500/US30 CFDs (P6 vol-managed long, R1 dip ensemble entered 14:00 ET, P1 IBS<0.3 entered 16:00 ET). Point-in-time equal risk, 30-day vol targeting. Simulation only.

frozen.daily_stop: flat for the rest of the UTC day once the day's loss reaches 50% of the 5% daily loss limit (2.5%), exit 10 bp worse (Gen230 setting)
frozen.costs: commission 1.2 bp per side + half the measured BrightFunded MT5 spread per side (research_data/firm_specs/BrightFunded*20261021*.csv: BTC 0.36, ETH 6.2, SOL 3.7 ... bp full spread); no swap (swap-free add-on); index CFDs 1 bp per side
frozen.booking: every sleeve as hourly positions x hourly returns; Weiss legs in their bars
frozen.risk_note: Gen230/236: 2.0 in the challenge, 1.5 once funded; the paper ledger runs at the challenge risk
frozen.index_data: Dukascopy hourly BID bars (research copy + src/qpl/live/index_feed.py: monthly hour candles, last 48 h from tick files); the cutoff waits at most 1 hour for a late bar
frozen.ridge_inputs_extra: Binance spot BTC/ETH hourly klines with taker-buy volume (src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py spot), Deribit DVOL level
frozen.bf22_scale_note: 0.15 / realised vol 2022-26 of the point-in-time bf2.2 book with the 1:5 crypto cap at risk 2.0 (computed 2026-10-21 by paper_v5.py _dump on the research pack): 2.496 / 2022 0.523 / 2023-24 3.800 / 2025-26 2.247, vol 0.150; uncapped research Gen302 A 2.501 / 0.523 / 3.812 / 2.247

frozen_ledger: Each completed hour is computed once, with only the data available at that moment, and never revised. Hours computed more than 2 hours after they closed are flagged late.

gate.minimum: 56 days of paper results and at least 2 Weiss expiry events
gate.reconciliation: recompute the period with the final data: hourly portfolio P&L correlation >= 0.99 and |cumulative difference| <= 0.5% of the account; otherwise find and fix the cause before going further
gate.operations: late or missed hours <= 5% of hours; no data errors
gate.performance: z = (paper mean daily return - backtest mean) / (backtest daily sd / sqrt(days)), backtest = the bf2.2 book 2023-01..2026-09 at the same risk. GO if z > -1; EXTEND to 112 days if -2 <= z <= -1; STOP if z < -2 or the paper drawdown is worse than -12%
gate.honesty_note: 56 days cannot prove the edge (one standard error is about the whole expected return). The paper test mainly proves that the pipeline runs live without look-ahead, data gaps or execution surprises.
